column1: # WirelessManager 1.3 (28.8.2013), wpa_supplicant v0.7.3: every SANA-II request it makes.
# Binary: C:WirelessManager sha256 9d2e45a8b00d7990abadf3591b0b9b20de92e6988ad899f5ec89165dc86c7efe
#   (Aminet driver/net/prism2v2; byte-identical to the A1200's). bin = file offset of its io_Command store.
# Source: AROS master workbench/network/WirelessManager/src/drivers/driver_sana2.c (Cafferkey 2010-2013);
#   the source is not tied to the binary by a tag, but its 21 io_Command stores map 1:1 onto the binary's, in order.
# IOSana2Req offsets: io_Command 28, io_Flags 30, io_Error 31, ios2_WireError/io_Actual 32,
#   ios2_PacketType/io_Length 36, ios2_SrcAddr 40 (io_Data 40..43), ios2_DstAddr 56, ios2_DataLength 72,
#   ios2_Data 76, ios2_StatData 80, ios2_BufferManagement 84; sizeof 88.
# req: M = drv->request, CreateIORequest(port, 88) = MEMF_CLEAR, OpenDevice'd once, reused for every DoIO below.
#   E = EAPOL read, AllocVec(88+1500, CLEAR) then CopyMem(M, 88): inherits EVERY M field at copy time.
#   R = MLME read x MLME_REQ_COUNT, same copy rule.  V = event request, AllocVec(88, CLEAR) + copy of M.
#   T = WM's timer.device request (eloop), not sent to this driver.
# order

column1: # Deinit: AbortIO E, each R, V, M; CloseDevice(M).
# Rows 22-23: value 9 is also S2_DEVICEQUERY, so they are listed to show the two stores are timer.device's
#   (movea.l $58,a0 -> a timerequest; tr_time written at offset 32), not a SANA-II device query.
# NSCMD_DEVICEQUERY expected outcomes (release gate for beta7):
#   WM form (row 1: full 88-byte request, first command after Open, io_Length/PacketType 0, io_Data = 16 B preset {0,16}) -> io_Error 0, 16 B header filled, SupportedCommands set.

#   Same 88-byte request after S2_CONFIGINTERFACE (SrcAddr = station address, so io_Data = its first 4 bytes), PacketType 0 -> must NOT write through io_Data. UNRESOLVED: no bit pattern alone distinguishes it from row 1 (HOLD, codex 08:05).
#   SANA-II form (ios2_Data non-NULL, ios2_DataLength >= 16) -> writes ios2_Data only.  Short IOStdReq (mn_Length 48) -> io_Data, as beta4.
